definitions.full: H8299. sarig [ שָׂרִיג ] noun masculine Gen 40:10 tendril, twig (from interlacing ; compare Arabic palm-leaf braid , etc.; Ethiopic net (Prä BASi. 371 ); Aramaic סְרִיגָא , network, lattice ); — of vine, plural שָׂרִיגִם 40:10 , שָׂרִגִים 40:12 ; of fig-tree, suffix שָׂרִיגֶיהָ Joel 1:7 .
